_설명: 스토리 인트로(모션 코믹, D-100) 컷 그림 요청 글 — Gemini 웹(크롬 조종), 컷마다 새 대화 + 참고 그림 첨부. 결과는 assets/sprites/intro/st<N>/<칸>.webp (tools/images/build_intro_art.py). 참고 그림: 주인공 = MD/캐릭터 컨셉.png에서 자른 것(3배, 합성괴인 chimera = 1차 (1332,44)-(1536,282), 길잡이 diver = 2차 (1126,4)-(1382,226), 성녀 saint = 3차 (205,8)-(505,252), 인형사 doll = 3차 (728,10)-(1024,250), 무희 frost = 3차 (1252,5)-(1536,250), 설계자 architect = 4차 (300,36)-(652,348) ×2, 방송자 broadcaster = 4차 (942,30)-(1318,348) ×2 글자 지움), 적 = assets/sprites/stage/src/st<N>/<적>_1_gpt.png
_공통: Generate an image (not a description). Draw ONE wide 16:9 landscape comic panel in the same 16-bit pixel art style as the attached image(s) (dark, gritty, detailed pixel art, cinematic lighting). … The art fills the whole frame. No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no panel borders.

items.scene: wide establishing shot inside an abandoned top-secret underground military research bunker 1,000 meters below ground ('Laboratory 14'): endless dark steel girders and catwalks, giant ventilation fans, rows of server racks with burning research data, collapsed concrete, hanging cables, red emergency alarm lights bathing everything in blood-red light, blue electric sparks. Palette: cold steel grey, emergency crimson red, spark blue. No characters.

Victor, the mad scientist — the same young-looking man with messy white hair and round glasses who sits inside the glass dome of the attached robot — drawn OUTSIDE the robot in a stained white lab coat, standing in a dark lab on the left third, glaring with cold anger at a large glowing cyan holographic monitor on the right that shows a missile / weapon-of-mass-destruction blueprint with red warning marks. Cyan monitor light on his face, glasses reflecting.

the Dimensional Portal: a huge circular ring machine in the center of the dark bunker lab, fed by dozens of thick power cables, a swirling blue-violet dimensional rift tearing open space inside the ring, crackling blue sparks; small silhouette of Victor in his lab coat on the left, one hand raised toward it.

a massive reinforced titanium blast door of the bunker being smashed inward from outside — bulging dents, flying bolts, sparks and dust, yellow-black warning stripes, red alarm lights. Vertical composition: the door is centered and fills the middle third; left and right thirds are plain dark steel walls.

government secret strike force 'Black Hound' storming into the bunker through smoke: soldiers in black tactical armor and helmets with a red hound emblem (as attached), riot shield troopers in front, rifles with red laser sights, red alarm light. The squad leader in the right foreground shouting an order.

close-up of Victor (the white-haired scientist with round glasses from the robot's dome, in a lab coat) on the left, smiling with a cold sinister grin, his hand gripping a big red lever on a control console, console screens and red emergency light, light glinting on his glasses.

the prototype giant robot from the attached image (dark grey-blue armored mech, glass dome cockpit with white-haired Victor inside, purple energy canister on its back, blue lights) bursting out of the bunker hangar and charging to the right, steam, sparks, dust; black-armored soldiers on the right firing at it and falling back. Low-angle heroic shot, red alarm lights and a beam of light from an opened ceiling hatch.

wide establishing shot of a giant energy corporation's coastal drilling complex carved brutally into the coastline: oil derricks, refinery pipes, cranes, huge smokestacks belching black smoke into a smog sky, cut-away rocky cliffs, polluted dark sea. Magma red, concrete grey, rust brown. No characters.

underwater: a massive nuclear test explosion on the deep sea floor — blinding white-orange fireball and shockwave ring expanding underwater, drill pipes descending from above, the seabed crust cracking open, bubbles everywhere, dark blue water.

deep in the dark abyss under the cracked seabed, the head of the ancient colossus from the attached image half-buried in rock and darkness; only ONE huge glowing yellow reptile eye is opening, lighting the dark water. Very dark close-up.

the attached kaiju rising out of a boiling sea in front of the burning coastal drilling complex, roaring at the sky, volcanic rock and coral on its body, steam and lava glow, derricks on fire behind it, waves crashing. Epic low-angle wide shot.

terrified corporate mercenaries (yellow hard hat, gas mask, orange gear as attached) screaming and firing rifles upward, an orange industrial bulldozer robot (as attached) rolling in behind them, firelight and smoke. Main mercenary in the left foreground.
extreme close-up of the attached kaiju's face roaring furiously on the right side of the frame, glowing yellow eyes, open jaws with teeth, moss, embers and heat haze, orange firelight.

wide establishing shot of a holy kingdom's lavish capital: golden gothic cathedral spires subtly twisted and corrupted, a long white-marble pilgrimage road leading from an execution square with gallows to a giant cathedral, blood-red sunset sky. Faded gold, blood red, abyssal black. No characters.

sepia flashback: public execution in a town square — the white-haired hero (as attached, without his dark aura) kneeling in chains on a wooden scaffold, an executioner knight in gold-and-white armor (as attached) raising a huge greatsword above him, an angry crowd of hooded fanatics with torches and pitchforks below.
close-up of the attached hero being engulfed by dark purple-black demonic power: his left eye blazing violet, black-purple flames and ghostly wisps swirling around his face, dark red background.

dusk in the execution square: the attached fallen hero rising from a burst of purple-black energy, glowing purple sword, surrounded by swirling ghostly spirits of his executed comrades, broken gallows behind, terrified hooded fanatics with torches stepping back on the right.
close-up portrait of the attached hero on the left side, cold expression with a faint bitter smile, violet glowing eye, purple aura and speed lines, dark background.

Archbishop Benedict (as attached: gold-and-white papal robes with red crosses, tall mitre, grey beard, huge steel cross-staff) on the right, standing in golden light beams from a cathedral stained-glass window and pointing forward commandingly, his eyes and robe hems subtly dark red.

the attached fallen hero marching forward to the right down a blood-stained white-marble pilgrimage road toward the golden cathedral, purple aura and ghost spirits trailing behind, a line of holy shield knights and hooded fanatics with torches blocking the road on the right, golden stained-glass light and red sunset.

wide establishing shot of 'the Cradle of Flesh': an organic alien laboratory hidden inside a dimensional rift — pulsating walls of red flesh and ribs, rows of giant translucent cocoon-shaped incubation tanks full of glowing green amniotic fluid with twisted creatures curled inside, bioluminescent green veins, torn holes in reality showing a starry violet void sky. Palette: void purple, fleshy crimson, bioluminescent green. No characters in front.

inside a giant glass incubation cocoon-tank filled with glowing green fluid: the attached chimera creature (tiger-striped pig-faced beast with horns and bat wings) curled up asleep, dozens of tubes and needles stuck into his body, while tall shadowy cosmic beings with many glowing eyes watch coldly through the glass from the dark on the right.

extreme close-up of the attached chimera's face behind the green-tinted tank glass: one eye snapping wide open and glowing yellow, bubbles rising, a sharp crack spreading across the glass in front of the eye. Dark green and violet tones.

the attached chimera bursting out of a shattered giant cocoon-tank, roaring with arms spread and wings opening, a huge wave of glowing green amniotic fluid and glass shards gushing out around him, steam; on the right, tumor-covered mutant fanatics (as attached) recoiling in fear. Flesh lab background, violet and green light.
close-up portrait of the attached chimera on the left side, snarling with bared tusks, green fluid dripping from his face and horns, furious glowing yellow eyes, speed lines, dark violet background.

the boss Oculus, Overseer of Evolution (as attached: humanoid upper body with an enormous exposed brain, lower body a giant cosmic worm with many tangled arms and legs), looming on the right side in purple darkness, many glowing eyes, raising one hand as if observing an experiment, eerie green glow from below.

the attached chimera marching forward to the right through a fleshy organic corridor, wings half open, toward a gigantic ominous cosmic cocoon in the far distance whose thousands of tentacles reach up into a violet starry void sky; tumor-covered mutant fanatics and bone-shield beasts (as attached) blocking the path on the right. Void purple, crimson flesh, bioluminescent green.

wide establishing shot of the colossal sea fortress 'Poseidon': dark steel platforms, gun turrets and towers on giant pillars rising from a black storm-tossed ocean at night, lightning and heavy rain, a sickly orange glow deep under the water (toxic volcano), a thin strip of the last land far behind. Palette: abyssal blue-black, corroded brass, toxic magma orange. No characters.

dark underwater flashback: a deep-sea volcano erupting toxic orange magma on the sea floor, a team of divers in brass diving suits being engulfed by boiling poisoned water and ash, and the big brass-helmeted diver (as attached) reaching out helplessly toward them. Murky blue-black water, orange glow.

close-up of the attached diver's brass helmet in pitch-black deep water, the round porthole window glowing eerie orange from inside, ghostly teal spirits of drowned crew swirling around the helmet, bubbles rising.

night storm, heavy rain and lightning: the first attached giant brass deep-sea diver climbing up over the edge of a steel sea-fortress deck, ripping a huge anchor chain apart with one hand, black mud and glowing toxic teal water pouring off his suit, ghostly drowned-crew spirits around him; on the right, navy marines in waterproof suits with harpoon guns (like the second attached image) stumbling back in terror.

close-up of the attached diver's brass helmet and shoulders on the LEFT third of the frame, porthole glowing orange, toxic teal water dripping, ghostly spirit wisps, speed lines; the right two thirds is dark stormy blue-black background.

the boss Admiral Ironclad exactly as attached (a towering super-mecha built from a nuclear submarine hull, arrogant commander in the cockpit) on the RIGHT half of the frame on a storm-lashed fortress deck, cannon ports opening, searchlights, rain and lightning; left third dark stormy sky.

the first attached brass deep-sea diver on the LEFT, marching forward to the right along a rain-soaked steel fortress deck dragging a huge anchor, teal ghost spirits trailing; navy harpoon marines (second attached) and steel hatch-shield soldiers (third attached) blocking the way on the right; a gigantic cylindrical central drilling rig tower glowing orange in the stormy distance.

wide establishing shot of the 'Grand Ward of Miracles', a corrupt church's luxury hospital: sterile white marble hall with gilded gothic arches and huge stained-glass windows, lavish VIP beds of rich nobles on life support, red blood-transfusion tubes running from rows of chained pale poor patients to the nobles, a floating ruby-red diamond-shaped heart glowing above a golden altar in the far distance. warm sepia flashback: the attached white-hooded saint with a golden halo, as she once was — gentle, unarmed, kneeling and bandaging a poor sick child in a humble candle-lit clinic; behind her through an open doorway, shadowy church priests in gold robes secretly smothering a patient she had healed. Warm candlelight versus cold shadows.
close-up of the attached saint's face: wide red eyes trembling, tears of blood running down, her golden halo above cracking apart, stitches and red threads drifting around, dark crimson background.

a huge stained-glass window shattering as the first attached saint crashes down into a blood-stained luxurious VIP hospital ward, giant drill-syringe in hand, glass shards and colored light rays everywhere; stitched undead 'suture dolls' dragging chains crawl in behind her; on the right, terrified rich nobles and corrupt priests with giant scalpels and bone saws (like the second attached image) recoiling.

close-up portrait of the attached saint on the LEFT third of the frame, calm but deranged gentle smile, glowing red eyes, golden halo, red threads floating, speed lines; the right two thirds is dark crimson empty background.

on the RIGHT half: the boss 'Grail of Miracles: Heart of Greed' (as the first attached image: a huge floating diamond-shaped blood-red jewel connected by hundreds of transfusion tubes like veins, pulsing like a real heart) above a golden altar, with an armored church war-surgeon (as the second attached image) standing below it pointing forward; the left third is dark golden cathedral-ward background.

the first attached saint on the LEFT marching forward to the right through a blood-stained white-and-gold hospital ward, giant drill-syringe raised, stitched undead suture dolls dragging chains behind her; iron-maiden shield knights (second attached) and scalpel priests (third attached) blocking the way on the right; the floating ruby heart-shaped grail pulsing above a golden altar in the far distance.

artillery shells streaking down from a grey ash sky onto a small wooden orphanage building, a huge explosion of sickly yellow fire and smoke tearing it apart, toys and debris flying. No people visible.
